candidate.title: The `ValidateCAA` feature gate has been deprecated and will be removed in cert-manager v1.18
candidate.text:
The `ValidateCAA` feature gate has been deprecated and will be removed in cert-manager v1.18. If you're manually enabling this feature gate, it's advisable to stop.
